set.body: Active direction: docs/VISION.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md, reconciled 2026-09-17. Complete the pinned eyesim baseline through clear public workflows, typed persistence, independently developed extensions and a headless application consumer, then accept and stabilize the foundation. Fixation, recording and temporal plan/codec routes, method descriptors, preflight and bounded study preview are implemented within their documented limits. This tranche adds a direct repetition facade, compiled saved/exported phase workflow, task-first index and measured reference divergence. Remaining gates: every required baseline gap, training-only template fit, second extension-family and packaged consumer proof, documentation CI and operational/release evidence. Reuse existing tasks and bounded ownership; no new Workflow framework. The separate UI and licensed EDF certification do not gate pure core development. Historical/local test evidence is not hosted release acceptance. Broad epic stays open/unassigned.
